div.div: جَسُورٌ Daring, courageous, or bold: (S, A:) or courageous and tall; as also ↓ جَسْرٌ : (K:) or courageous; and also tall and bulky; applied to a man; and so ↓ جَسْرٌ : (TA:) fem. of the former without, and sometimes with, ة: (Msb:) and of the latter with ة: (TA:) pl. of the former جُسُرٌ and جُسْرٌ. (K, TA.) It is not applied to a hecamel; but with ة is applied to a she-camel, meaning Bold to traverse rugged, or difficult, tracts. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
